sources.content: Rowan may explore low-load training with pacing and accessibility supports. The note gives no opinion on full-time work capacity.
An adaptive keyboard and reclined setup allowed a 70-minute document session, followed by increased symptoms and most of the next day spent recovering. Repeatability is unknown.
Rowan hoped to return immediately to a full-time remote role. This goal has not been reconfirmed.
Equipment and training supports can be discussed after eligibility and planning review. No service or funding is approved.
APPROVED: Rowan is ready for full-time work and the counselor will fund a new computer.
